featured.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
featured.summaryEn: Box CEO Aaron Levie posted three takes on agent architecture and compute. First, he called a new piece of research a preview of where agent architecture must end up: once AI sees the task at hand, it will be better at choosing its own harness than humans designing one in advance. Second, he expects agent swarms to become core to enterprise workflows, because massively parallelizable problems will be too valuable not to throw compute at. Cyber is a prime beneficiary, since exploring a huge space of attack permutati…
featured.insightZh: Box CEO Aaron Levie 今天连发三条，主线是「Agent 架构与算力消耗」。第一，他认为一项新研究指出了 Agent 的终局架构：AI 在看到具体任务后自己决定 harness，最终一定比人提前设计得更好。第二，他判断 Agent Swarm 会成为企业工作流的核心，能大规模并行的问题都值得砸算力，其中网络安全受益最大：攻击路径的排列组合搜索空间巨大，需要把多个场景串成完整利用链，这会成为大企业最大的 token 消耗场景之一。第三，Meta 全面进入前沿模型竞争后，多家同时推动 SOTA，会进一步加速进步，同时压低最高能力档位的 token 价格。

featured.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
featured.summaryEn: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch argued that coding CLIs are getting too complicated, with daemons, three layers of TUIs, and client-server architectures. The point of a CLI is to deliver intelligence with zero friction and stay Unix-like, so he pointed to a 6MB, millisecond-startup, model-agnostic CLI with MCP, Skills, Subagents and ACP built in. He also announced that Meta's Muse Wonder is now available on Vercel AI Gateway via `fx --model meta/muse-wonder-1.0`.
featured.insightZh: Vercel CEO Guillermo Rauch 吐槽现在的编程 CLI 越做越复杂：守护进程、三层 TUI、客户端-服务端架构。他认为 CLI 的意义是零摩擦地交付智能、保持 Unix 风格，并推荐了一个 6MB、毫秒级启动、模型无关的极简 CLI，内置 MCP、Skills、Subagents 和 ACP。另外他宣布 Meta 的 Muse Wonder 已上线 Vercel AI Gateway，可通过 `fx --model meta/muse-wonder-1.0` 直接调用。

featured.title: How Sam Altman Uses Dots to Take Back His Time
featured.summaryEn: At OpenAI Dev Day, Sam Altman says Dots, the new always-on background agent, gave him back his mornings for deep work. He frames AI as a human-centered Renaissance rather than an Industrial Revolution that turns people into cogs, and says OpenAI now aims to democratize speed the way it has driven down the price of intelligence. In the first episode under the new Every Podcast name, Dan Shipper interviews Altman live at Dev Day, where OpenAI launched about 22 things (versus about 9 last year) and still cut more. Altman says strong coding models have brought more developers, not fewer, because latent demand and expectations are enormous and people stay at the center: we care far more about other people than about what machines do. items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Every CEO Dan Shipper tested Meta's new Muse Wonder by having it make a video explaining personal benchmarks. His verdict: pretty rough, and every video so far has been narrated in an Australian accent. He clarified that this was Muse Wonder Standard, since Wonder Full is inexplicably not on the API, and said he would run it again later. The service went down and came back up, but was "still bad."
items.insightZh: Every CEO Dan Shipper 上手实测了 Meta 新模型 Muse Wonder，用它生成一段讲解「个人 benchmark」的视频，评价直接：效果相当粗糙，而且目前生成的视频全是澳洲口音旁白。他补充说明测的是 Muse Wonder Standard，Wonder Full 版本莫名其妙没有开放 API，之后会再跑一轮。服务中途宕机又恢复，但「依然不行」。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT
items.summaryEn: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT lead Thibault Sottiaux announced that usage limits have been reset ("What would you like with your side of reset? It's done.") and teased a simple plan that should give everyone significantly more usage, which he hopes to ship soon.
items.insightZh: OpenAI Codex & ChatGPT 负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 宣布用量额度已经重置（"What would you like with your side of reset? It's done."），并预告手上有一个「简单的好计划」，落地后所有人可用的用量会显著增加，希望尽快完成。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 作者、OpenAI
items.summaryEn: OpenClaw creator Peter Steinberger (now at OpenAI) shared a hands-on take: 6.1 Sol ultrafast is far better than 6 Astra at roughly the same cost, and at 250 tpm it feels like a whole different game. He also repeated last year's point that "vibe coding" is a slur.
items.insightZh: OpenClaw 作者 Peter Steinberger（现在 OpenAI）给出一个模型使用体感：6.1 Sol ultrafast 明显强于 6 Astra，成本差不多，但 250 tpm 的速度让体验「完全是另一个游戏」。他还重申去年的观点：「vibe coding」这个说法是一种贬低。

items.title: Aditya Agarwal · South Park Commons 合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO
items.summaryEn: South Park Commons GP and former Dropbox CTO Aditya Agarwal noted a big delta between how frontier lab employees use AI and how even the top 1% of AI orgs use it, and that is with public capabilities only. He expects the gap to persist for a while and sees a company opportunity in a horizontal accelerant that closes it.
items.insightZh: South Park Commons 普通合伙人、前 Dropbox CTO Aditya Agarwal 观察到：前沿实验室员工使用 AI 的方式，和哪怕是最顶尖 1% 的 AI 组织之间都存在巨大落差，而且这还是只用公开能力的情况下。他认为这个差距会持续一段时间，其中藏着一个「横向加速器」式的创业机会。

items.title: Peter Yang · Roblox 产品负责人、AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: AI tutorials creator Peter Yang explained why Grok Bot is his favorite agent right now: it is built on personas instead of chat threads, so it feels like hiring employees who each own a job. Behind the Growth handles customer support, YouTube Producer does research and prep, Loving Husband runs family errands, and Health Coach keeps workouts on track. New features include free X access, its own email, and Opus. He also lamented that the new StarCraft won't arrive until 2030 and urged Blizzard to double down on the…
items.insightZh: AI 教程创作者 Peter Yang 解释了为什么 Grok Bot 是他目前最喜欢的 Agent：它的组织方式是「角色」而不是对话线程，感觉像雇了几个员工，各管一摊。他的 Behind the Growth 负责客服，YouTube Producer 负责调研和准备，Loving Husband 负责家庭杂事，Health Coach 盯训练。新功能包括免费 X 访问、独立邮箱和 Opus 模型。另外他感慨 StarCraft 新作要到 2030 年，呼吁暴雪加码这个 IP。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Builder、Follow Builders 作者
items.summaryEn: Builder Zara Zhang shared a touching AI coding story. A friend grew up in a home full of cockroaches, and her mom turned killing them into a game. Another friend vibe coded a game from that story where you catch cockroaches and compete against Mom, and she cried while playing it. The game isn't technically sophisticated and any model can build it quickly now. What gives it a soul is the human story and emotion behind it. Code is the new medium for storytelling.
items.insightZh: Builder Zara Zhang 分享了一个让她很触动的 AI coding 故事：朋友小时候家里蟑螂多，妈妈把打蟑螂变成游戏。另一个朋友听了这个故事后，vibe code 了一个「在房间里抓蟑螂、和妈妈比赛」的小游戏，当事人边玩边哭。游戏技术上并不复杂，任何模型都能很快做出来，真正赋予它灵魂的是背后的人、经历和情感。她的结论是：代码是新的讲故事媒介。

items.title: Ryo Lu · Cursor 设计负责人
items.summaryEn: Cursor designer Ryo Lu shipped two new apps on ryOS: Dictionary (vocabulary, pronunciation, kanji) and Fitness (AI-planned workouts plus body and food tracking). Both sync to your ryOS account and were built with Cursor.
items.insightZh: Cursor 设计负责人 Ryo Lu 在个人项目 ryOS 上新增了两个应用：Dictionary（学单词、发音、汉字）和 Fitness（用 AI 规划训练、记录身体和饮食数据），都同步到 ryOS 账户，用 Cursor 等工具做出来。

items.title: Josh Woodward · Google Labs / Gemini App VP
items.summaryEn: Google Labs and Gemini App VP Josh Woodward appeared on Lenny's podcast. He had learned from Lenny for years but they had never met, and he praised Lenny as prepared and deeply curious, saying the conversation went to places he has never discussed in public.
items.insightZh: Google Labs / Gemini App VP Josh Woodward 上了 Lenny 的播客。他说跟 Lenny 学习多年但这是第一次见面，Lenny 准备充分、好奇心强，把对话带到了他从未公开谈过的话题。

items.title: Swyx · Latent Space、AI Engineer 主理人
items.summaryEn: Latent Space and AI Engineer host Swyx announced that the workshop writeup from AI Engineer NY is live, and noted a packed room for the Arize AI workshop. He called bringing out the best in AI in each city one of the best parts of his job.
items.insightZh: Latent Space、AI Engineer 主理人 Swyx 宣布 AI Engineer NY 的 workshop 总结文章已发布，Arize AI 的 workshop 也座无虚席。他说这份工作最好的部分之一，就是把每个城市里最好的 AI 实践带出来。
